title: Realtime Analytics Dashboard
subtitle: Live operational metrics for edge device fleets
description: A web dashboard that streams live telemetry from 500+ edge devices and surfaces alerts within seconds.
technologies: TypeScript, React, Node.js, WebSockets, Redis, PostgreSQL
overview: A production dashboard used by the operations team to monitor fleet health in real time, with per-device drilldowns and configurable alert rules.
highlights: Sub-second p95 render latency for 500+ concurrent device streams
Configurable alert thresholds with webhook and email delivery
challenges: Keeping the UI responsive under bursty traffic
Designing an alert rule engine that non-engineers could configure
outcomes: Incident detection time dropped from 15 minutes to under 20 seconds
Ops team fully transitioned off the legacy polling dashboard
results: Cut incident detection time to under 20 seconds.

title: Inventory ML Forecaster
subtitle: Gradient boosting model for weekly inventory planning
description: A LightGBM model that forecasts weekly inventory needs for a regional retail chain, served through a FastAPI endpoint.
overview: Replaced spreadsheet-based forecasting with a model trained on three years of sales data plus external features like local weather and holiday calendars.
highlights: MAPE of 8.4% on a held-out 12-week window
Served predictions via a FastAPI endpoint with Dockerized deployment
Weekly retraining pipeline with model drift alerts
challenges: Cold-start for new SKUs with limited history
Aligning multiple data sources with inconsistent granularity
outcomes: Over-ordering reduced by 22% in the first quarter
Buyer team adopted model output as the default starting point

title: Open-Source Markdown Editor
subtitle: Local-first browser markdown editor
description: A browser-based markdown editor with live preview, PDF export, and IndexedDB-backed local storage.
overview: A zero-backend markdown editor that stores documents locally and supports collaborative editing via optional CRDT sync.
highlights: PDF export using a WASM build of the rendering pipeline
outcomes: Actively used by documentation teams at three companies
Recognized in the 2024 JS Rising Stars list

title: Legacy Migration Toolkit
subtitle: Codemods and CLI for a 200k-line TypeScript migration
description: Internal tooling that drove the migration of a large JavaScript codebase to strict TypeScript.
overview: A collection of codemods plus a migration-tracking CLI that allowed the team to convert the codebase file-by-file while keeping main green.
highlights: CLI dashboard tracked progress and blockers per team
Migration completed on schedule with no production regressions
outcomes: Tooling retired once the migration was complete
